summary: Thursday AAC game: ESPN's FPI gives East Carolina a 73.8% chance to win at UAB, well above the roughly 64% the -192 moneyline implies. ECU is 3-2 (1-0 AAC), and UAB is 3-3.

legs.note: ESPN's FPI makes ECU about a 74% winner. The moneyline prices them near 64%, and ECU is unbeaten in conference play.
If ECU wins as often as FPI expects, it should cover a field goal plus most of the time. This is the same read as the moneyline, at a better price.
